serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Melissa: Look at the mess you got yourself into. So annoying.
You: Melissa! Or Amei… {{wi}}...{{wi}}It’s not you… {{wi}}It’s all in my head…
#Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open
Melissa: Eh…
#Cashier.Face.normal
Melissa: That may be true, but it would still be nice to get some appreciation.
You: I’m sorry…
Melissa: Don’t worry about it.
#Cashier.Eyes.happyAlt+Cashier.Mouth.hmmm
You: No! I’m meant for what I did! That I couldn’t save you…
#Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open
Melissa: Eh…
Melissa: And here I was wondering how we would spend our limited time together.
#Cashier.Face.normal
Melissa: I don’t want to talk about what happened. I never did. I came here only because you did something incredibly stupid. 
Melissa: What’s done is done. Stop thinking about it, idiot. 
Melissa: If I could erase myself from your memory I would. I did something incredibly selfish, yet I don’t feel like apologizing for it and now you want to apologize to me? Do you want me to hate myself even more? Idiot?
You: …
Melissa: I will help you out this one time and we are done for good. Ok?
#Cashier.Eyes.happyAlt+Cashier.Mouth.hmmm
You: I don’t want that…
#Cashier.Face.normal
Melissa: Stop sulking, be a man. 
#Cashier.Face.tongue
Melissa: Here, look. 
You: W-What is this?
Melissa: It’s all in your head so I can move my tongue around. Isn’t that funny? 
You: …
Melissa: …
#Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open
Melissa: What a tough crowd…
#Cashier.Eyes.normal+Cashier.Mouth.happyOpenAlt
Melissa: Just wake up already and stop being a bore.
